Name: Mermaid Paths and Flooring
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
for those who love mermaids or the sea in general~

. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[img]https://imgur.com/4pncZL1.png[/img]
1. download and install alternative textures
2. download this mod
3. unzip contents into stardew's mod folder

﻿[img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]
♡ how to use: purchase the paint bucket from robin and use it on the following paths/flooring to change to their corresponding mermaid versions:
[b]Crystal Floor[/b] - mermaid floor versions 1, 2 and 3
[b]Gravel Path[/b] - seaweed, red algae, sea anemone, sea fan, soft coral
[b]Stepping Stone Path[/b] - mixed shells and stars, pink shell, blue shell, aqua shell, purple shell, small pink shell, small blue shell, small aqua shell, small purple shell, cute pink shell, white shell, small cute pink shell, small white shell
♡ the red algae, sea anemone, sea fan and soft coral sprites are from my water flowers and sea plants mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16372)
♡ sprites made by me
